      #
      #   # good

      #
      class RedundantParentheses < Base
        include Parentheses
        extend AutoCorrector

        ALLOWED_NODE_TYPES = %i[and or send splat kwsplat].freeze

        # @!method square_brackets?(node)
        def_node_matcher :square_brackets?, '(send {(send _recv _msg) str array hash} :[] ...)'

        # @!method method_node_and_args(node)

          empty_parentheses?(node) ||
            first_arg_begins_with_hash_literal?(node) ||
            rescue?(node) ||
            allowed_pin_operator?(node) ||
            allowed_expression?(node)
        end

        def ignore_syntax?(node)
          return false unless (parent = node.parent)

            allowed_method_call?(node) ||
            allowed_multiple_expression?(node) ||
            allowed_ternary?(node) ||
            node.parent&.range_type?
        end

        def allowed_ancestor?(node)
          # Don't flag `break(1)`, etc
          keyword_ancestor?(node) && parens_required?(node)
        end

        def allowed_method_call?(node)
          # Don't flag `method (arg) { }`
          arg_in_call_with_block?(node) && !parentheses?(node.parent)
        end

        def allowed_multiple_expression?(node)
          return false if node.children.one?

          ancestor = node.ancestors.first
          return false unless ancestor

          !ancestor.begin_type? && !ancestor.def_type? && !ancestor.block_type?
        end

        def allowed_ternary?(node)
          return false unless node&.parent&.if_type?

          node.parent.ternary? && ternary_parentheses_required?
        end

        def ternary_parentheses_required?
          config = @config.for_cop('Style/TernaryParentheses')
          allowed_styles = %w[require_parentheses require_parentheses_when_complex]

          config.fetch('Enabled') && allowed_styles.include?(config['EnforcedStyle'])
        end

        def like_method_argument_parentheses?(node)
          return false if !node.send_type? && !node.super_type? && !node.yield_type?

          node.arguments.one? && !node.parenthesized? &&
            !node.arithmetic_operation? && node.first_argument.begin_type?
        end

        def multiline_control_flow_statements?(node)
          return false unless (parent = node.parent)
          return false if parent.single_line?

          parent.return_type? || parent.next_type? || parent.break_type?
        end

        def empty_parentheses?(node)
          # Don't flag `()`
          node.children.empty?
        end

        def first_arg_begins_with_hash_literal?(node)
          # Don't flag `method ({key: value})` or `method ({key: value}.method)`
          hash_literal = method_chain_begins_with_hash_literal(node.children.first)
          if (root_method = node.each_ancestor(:send).to_a.last)
            parenthesized = root_method.parenthesized_call?
          end
          hash_literal && first_argument?(node) && !parentheses?(hash_literal) && !parenthesized
        end

        def method_chain_begins_with_hash_literal(node)
          return if node.nil?
          return node if node.hash_type?
          return unless node.send_type?

          method_chain_begins_with_hash_literal(node.children.first)
        end

        def check(begin_node)
          node = begin_node.children.first

          if (message = find_offense_message(begin_node, node))
            return offense(begin_node, message)
          end

          check_send(begin_node, node) if node.call_type?
        end

        # rubocop:disable Metrics/AbcSize, Metrics/CyclomaticComplexity, Metrics/MethodLength, Metrics/PerceivedComplexity
        def find_offense_message(begin_node, node)
          return 'a keyword' if keyword_with_redundant_parentheses?(node)
          return 'a literal' if disallowed_literal?(begin_node, node)
          return 'a variable' if node.variable?
          return 'a constant' if node.const_type?
          if node.lambda_or_proc? && (node.braces? || node.send_node.lambda_literal?)
            return 'an expression'
          end
          return 'an interpolated expression' if interpolation?(begin_node)

          return if begin_node.chained?

          if node.and_type? || node.or_type?
            return if node.semantic_operator? && begin_node.parent
            return if node.multiline? && allow_in_multiline_conditions?
            return if ALLOWED_NODE_TYPES.include?(begin_node.parent&.type)
            return if begin_node.parent&.if_type? && begin_node.parent.ternary?

            'a logical expression'
          elsif node.respond_to?(:comparison_method?) && node.comparison_method?
            return unless begin_node.parent.nil?

            'a comparison expression'
          end
        end
        # rubocop:enable Metrics/AbcSize, Metrics/CyclomaticComplexity, Metrics/MethodLength, Metrics/PerceivedComplexity

        # @!method interpolation?(node)
        def_node_matcher :interpolation?, '[^begin ^^dstr]'

        def allow_in_multiline_conditions?
          parentheses_around_condition_config = config.for_cop('Style/ParenthesesAroundCondition')
          return false unless parentheses_around_condition_config['Enabled']

          !!parentheses_around_condition_config['AllowInMultilineConditions']
        end

        def check_send(begin_node, node)
          offense_message = nil
          skip_redundant_call_offense = false
          node_loc = node.loc

          selector_loc = if node_loc.respond_to?(:keyword)
                           node_loc.keyword
                         else
                           node_loc.selector
                         end

          unary_operation = false
          if selector_loc && node.operator_method?
            expression_loc = node_loc.expression
            expression_begin = expression_loc.begin_pos if expression_loc
            selector_begin = selector_loc.begin_pos
            if expression_loc && expression_begin == selector_begin
              unary_operation = true
            end
          end

          if unary_operation
            begin_parent = begin_node.parent
            chained_begin = begin_parent && begin_parent.call_type? && begin_node.eql?(begin_parent.receiver)
            unless chained_begin
              current = node
              while current.send_type? && current.unary_operation? && !current.prefix_not?
                current_children = current.children
                current = current_children.first
              end

              current_is_send = current.send_type?
              redundant_inner_call = method_call_with_redundant_parentheses?(current)
              skip_unary_offense = current_is_send && !redundant_inner_call
              unless skip_unary_offense
                offense_message = 'a unary operation'
              end
            end
          else
            unless node.call_type?
              skip_redundant_call_offense = true
            end

            receiver_node = node.receiver
            method_name = node.method_name
            prefix_not = false
            if receiver_node && method_name == :!
              not_selector = node_loc.selector
              if not_selector && not_selector.is?('not')
                prefix_not = true
              end
            end
            if prefix_not
              skip_redundant_call_offense = true
            end

            unless skip_redundant_call_offense
              raw_children = node.children
              receiver_child = raw_children[0]
              method_child = raw_children[1]
              argument_children = raw_children.drop(2)
              argument_count = argument_children.length
              args_empty = argument_count.zero?
              has_parens = parentheses?(node)
              square = false
              if node.send_type? && method_child == :[]
                recv = receiver_child
                if recv
                  recv_is_send = recv.send_type?
                  recv_is_str = recv.str_type?
                  recv_is_array = recv.array_type?
                  recv_is_hash = recv.hash_type?
                  if recv_is_send
                    square = true
                  elsif recv_is_str
                    square = true
                  elsif recv_is_array
                    square = true
                  elsif recv_is_hash
                    square = true
                  end
                end
              end

              redundant_call_parens = false
              if args_empty
                redundant_call_parens = true
              elsif has_parens
                redundant_call_parens = true
              elsif square
                redundant_call_parens = true
              end

              if redundant_call_parens
                first_receiver = node
                while first_receiver
                  receiver_type = first_receiver.type
                  send_like = receiver_type == :send
                  block_like = receiver_type == :block
                  safe_navigation = receiver_type == :csend
                  numbered_block = receiver_type == :numblock
                  if send_like
                    next_receiver = first_receiver.receiver
                    first_receiver = next_receiver
                  elsif block_like
                    send_of_block = first_receiver.send_node
                    first_receiver = send_of_block
                  elsif safe_navigation
                    break
                  elsif numbered_block
                    break
                  else
                    break
                  end
                end

                integer_receiver_with_unary_parent = false
                if first_receiver
                  integer_receiver = first_receiver.int_type?
                  if integer_receiver
                    parent_node = begin_node.parent
                    if parent_node
                      parent_is_send = parent_node.send_type?
                      if parent_is_send
                        unary_minus = parent_node.method?(:-@)
                        unary_plus = parent_node.method?(:+@)
                        if unary_minus || unary_plus
                          integer_receiver_with_unary_parent = true
                        end
                      end
                    end
                  end
                end

                if integer_receiver_with_unary_parent
                  skip_redundant_call_offense = true
                end

                unless skip_redundant_call_offense
                  offense_message = 'a method call'
                end
              end
            end
          end

          if offense_message
            offense_prefix = "Don't use parentheses around "
            offense_suffix = '.'
            offense_kind = offense_message
            offense_text = "#{offense_prefix}#{offense_kind}#{offense_suffix}"
            add_offense(begin_node, message: offense_text) do |corrector|
              begin_map = begin_node.loc
              begin_loc = begin_map.begin
              end_loc = begin_map.end
              opening_paren = begin_loc
              closing_paren = end_loc
              corrector.remove(opening_paren)
              corrector.remove(closing_paren)

              if end_loc
                source_range = begin_node.source_range
                source_buffer = source_range.source_buffer
                if source_buffer
                  closing_line_number = end_loc.line
                  line_range = source_buffer.line_range(closing_line_number)
                  if line_range
                    line_source = line_range.source
                    orphaned_comma_pattern = /\s*\)\s*,/
                    orphaned_comma = line_source.start_with?(orphaned_comma_pattern)
                    if orphaned_comma
                      src = source_buffer.source
                      begin_pos = end_loc.begin_pos
                      end_pos = end_loc.end_pos
                      if src
                        scan_pos = begin_pos
                        tab_or_space = /[ \t]/
                        while scan_pos.positive? && tab_or_space.match?(src[scan_pos - 1])
                          previous_index = scan_pos - 1
                          scan_pos = previous_index
                        end
                        if scan_pos.negative?
                          scan_pos = 0
                        end

                        continuation_token = "\\\n"
                        token_size = continuation_token.length
                        while scan_pos >= token_size && src[scan_pos - token_size, token_size] == continuation_token
                          scan_pos -= token_size
                        end
                        if scan_pos.negative?
                          scan_pos = 0
                        end

                        newline_char = "\n"
                        while scan_pos.positive? && src[scan_pos - 1] == newline_char
                          scan_pos -= 1
                        end
                        if scan_pos.negative?
                          scan_pos = 0
                        end

                        any_whitespace = /\s/
                        while scan_pos.positive? && any_whitespace.match?(src[scan_pos - 1])
                          scan_pos -= 1
                        end
                        if scan_pos.negative?
                          scan_pos = 0
                        end
                        begin_pos = scan_pos

                        child_nodes = begin_node.child_nodes
                        last_child = child_nodes.last
                        last_child_loc = last_child.loc
                        heredoc = last_child_loc.is_a?(Parser::Source::Map::Heredoc)
                        comma_match = nil
                        if heredoc
                          last_line_number = end_loc.last_line
                          last_line = source_buffer.source_line(last_line_number)
                          if last_line
                            last_column = end_loc.last_column
                            line_length = last_line.length
                            end_offset = line_length - last_column
                            closing_column = end_loc.column
                            adjusted_begin = -closing_column
                            comma_line = end_loc.adjust(begin_pos: adjusted_begin, end_pos: end_offset)
                            buffer_range = source_buffer.source_range
                            comma_line = comma_line.intersect(buffer_range)
                            comma_regexp = /(?<=\))\s*,/
                            comma_match = comma_line && comma_line.source.match(comma_regexp)
                          end
                        end
                        if comma_match && comma_match[0]
                          matched_text = comma_match[0]
                          matched_size = matched_text.size
                          end_pos += matched_size
                        end

                        range_buffer = source_buffer
                        range_begin_pos = begin_pos
                        range_end_pos = end_pos
                        parens_range = Parser::Source::Range.new(
                          range_buffer,
                          range_begin_pos,
                          range_end_pos
                        )
                        corrector.remove(parens_range)

                        if heredoc
                          corrector.insert_after(last_child, ',')
                        end
                      end
                    end
                  end
                end
              end

              parent_node = begin_node.parent
              parent_is_if = parent_node && parent_node.if_type?
              parent_is_ternary = parent_is_if && parent_node.ternary?
              if parent_is_ternary
                question_loc = parent_node.loc.question
                if question_loc
                  last_column = begin_node.loc.last_column
                  question_column = question_loc.column
                  if last_column == question_column
                    corrector.insert_after(end_loc, ' ')
                  end
                end
              end
            end
          end
        end

        def check_unary(begin_node, node)
          return if begin_node.chained?

          node = node.children.first while suspect_unary?(node)

          return if node.send_type? && !method_call_with_redundant_parentheses?(node)

          offense(begin_node, 'a unary operation')
        end

        def offense(node, msg)
          add_offense(node, message: "Don't use parentheses around #{msg}.") do |corrector|
            ParenthesesCorrector.correct(corrector, node)
          end
        end

        def suspect_unary?(node)
          node.send_type? && node.unary_operation? && !node.prefix_not?
        end

        def keyword_ancestor?(node)
          node.parent&.keyword?
        end

        def disallowed_literal?(begin_node, node)
          node.literal? && !node.range_type? && !raised_to_power_negative_numeric?(begin_node, node)
        end

        def raised_to_power_negative_numeric?(begin_node, node)
          return false unless node.numeric_type?

          next_sibling = begin_node.right_sibling
          return false unless next_sibling

          base_value = node.children.first

          base_value.negative? && next_sibling == :**
        end

        def keyword_with_redundant_parentheses?(node)
          return false unless node.keyword?
          return true if node.special_keyword?

          args = *node

          if only_begin_arg?(args)
            parentheses?(args.first)
          else
            args.empty? || parentheses?(node)
          end
        end

        def method_call_with_redundant_parentheses?(node)
          return false unless node.call_type?
          return false if node.prefix_not?

          send_node, args = method_node_and_args(node)

          args.empty? || parentheses?(send_node) || square_brackets?(send_node)
        end

        def only_begin_arg?(args)
          args.one? && args.first.begin_type?
        end

        def first_argument?(node)
          if first_send_argument?(node) ||
             first_super_argument?(node) ||
             first_yield_argument?(node)
            return true
          end

          node.each_ancestor.any? { |ancestor| first_argument?(ancestor) }
        end

        # @!method first_send_argument?(node)
        def_node_matcher :first_send_argument?, <<~PATTERN
          ^(send _ _ equal?(%0) ...)
        PATTERN

        # @!method first_super_argument?(node)
        def_node_matcher :first_super_argument?, <<~PATTERN
          ^(super equal?(%0) ...)
        PATTERN

        # @!method first_yield_argument?(node)
        def_node_matcher :first_yield_argument?, <<~PATTERN
          ^(yield equal?(%0) ...)
        PATTERN

        def call_chain_starts_with_int?(begin_node, send_node)
          recv = first_part_of_call_chain(send_node)
          recv&.int_type? && (parent = begin_node.parent) &&
            parent.send_type? && (parent.method?(:-@) || parent.method?(:+@))
        end
      end
    end
  end
end
